messages:
maria.g: Reopening the flaky-card repro thread — saw a node with recurring Xid 13 during a short job. Want to try a tighter smoke/driver-pin flow before deciding to replace the card.

ajay.k: Which node? stack/rack?

maria.g: node-gpu-23 (rack-b2-u4). GPU index 2, repeated ECC single-bit drift + Xid 13 in dmesg.

sasha: Quick note: the card passed the standard 6h burn previously but flakes after 10-20m under mixed TensorRT + memcpy workload.

maria.g: Hypothesis: recent driver bump (535.86 -> 536.x) + PCIe NB power gating changes. Want to repro with driver pinned back to 535.86 and add an explicit PCI reset loop to see if state clears then recurs.

ajay.k: Proposed steps:
1) repro rig: use node-gpu-23 in isolation (cordon + drain)
2) install driver 535.86 and matching CUDA libs
3) run mixed load loop (small script below) for 4 hours
4) if Xid appears, capture nvidia-smi -q, dmesg, lspci -vv

maria.g: Script (short):
```bash
for i in $(seq 1 9999); do
  python -c "import torch; a=torch.randn(2000,2000,'cuda'); b=a@a; del a; torch.cuda.synchronize()"
  nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps=pid,used_memory --format=csv
  sleep 10
  # occasional pci reset trigger
  if (( i % 30 == 0 )); then sudo bash -c 'echo 1 > /sys/bus/pci/devices/0000:3b:00.0/reset'; fi
done
```

burnin-bot: Scheduled extended-smoke job on node-gpu-23, job id burnin-4821, ETA 240m. Logs will be posted to s3://burnin-logs/node-gpu-23/burnin-4821/

tim-oncall: Quick warning: PCI reset on prod nodes can drop host context for other VMs, make sure this node is isolated and the reset path is validated.

sasha: Agreed. We'll do a cold-reboot baseline first, then driver pin + stress. Also enable ECC verbose logs: `nvidia-smi -q -d ECC` every 5m.

ajay.k: If Xid 13 recurs after pci reset + driver-pin, then it's likely HW or firmware. Capture vendor telemetry and escalate to replace. If it only happens with 536+, we update the burn-in checklist to pin 535 for returns and add PCI reset step.

maria.g: Also adding a remote power-cycle probe: `ipmi power cycle` after 2 hours if no repro to force thermal cycling.

sasha: Do we want to run memtestG80 / vendor memtest in parallel? Could catch VRAM bit flips.

maria.g: Yes, run memtest vendor tool for 30m in parallel on GPU2. Low priority but useful.

burnin-bot: burnin-4821 started @ 1829991250. Will push incremental logs and post if Xid events detected.

ajay.k: If reproducible, we'll update the return playbook to include: driver pin version, pci-reset loop, memtest window, 4h mixed-stress. If non-repro, mark as intermittent and hold for replacement if reappears in next 7 days.

maria.g: I'll collect traces on repro and open a vendor ticket with timestamps and `dmesg` dump. tagging @sasha and @tim-oncall for coordination. :mag:

burnin-bot: burnin-4821: Xid 13 observed at 1829991287. Capturing artifacts now.

maria.g: Got it — pulling logs. Starting vendor upload. Thanks everyone, will update the playbook PR with the driver-pin + pci reset snippet based on this run.

sasha: Nice, that was quick. If vendor confirms HW, we schedule replacement and update fleet health dashboard.

maria.g: Closing loop after vendor reply. For now, not returning node to service until we have either a clean 24h run or replacement ordered.
